Vendored frontend libraries for Neural Activity Explorer.
Runtime loads only these local files. No CDN script or module src.

three.min.js
  Package: three
  Version: 0.160.1
  License: MIT
  Copyright 2010-2023 three.js authors
  File: build/three.min.js (UMD). Animation uses reservoir state arrays.

streamlit-component-lib.js
  Streamlit custom-component iframe bridge, API version 1
  License: Apache-2.0
  Copyright Streamlit Inc. (2018-2022) / Snowflake Inc. (2022)
  Local browser shim of setComponentReady / onRender / setFrameHeight /
  setComponentValue. The npm package is ESM/React-only and is not used here.
